verdict.rationale: Bento's docs cover two parts of this story: a drag-and-drop editor for building templates, and reusable templates that update everywhere they're used across Sequences and Workflows. The only Liquid-variable evidence is for webhook payloads, so it isn't credited for email personalization. missing for 10: documented personalization/merge tokens in email content, evidence of correct rendering across email clients, on-brand styling controls (brand kits, saved blocks), independent or hands-on corroboration of the editor.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can design on-brand emails with a visual editor, reusable templates, and personalization tokens that render correctly across clients

citations.quote: Templates can be in plain text or built with our drag and drop editor.
Reusable: Create once, use in multiple Sequences or Workflows. Consistent: Changes to a template update it everywhere it's used
